provider_terminal.final_payload_summary: Completed one vessel through filtration, explicit termination, and final assay in 20 operations; the batch was not discarded. Charged 0.040 mol reagent, 25 mL acetonitrile, and 0.001 mol Catalyst A. HPLC after heating showed high conversion but low target selectivity, prompting quench and staged cooling to 250 K. Excessive fines prompted reheating to 290 K, adding 10 mg seed, and recooling; fines remained high. Final assay: crystal yield 0.0842 (target ≥0.10: fail), crystal purity 0.9737 (target ≥0.80: pass), and fines fraction 1.000 (target ≤0.50: fail). Thus 1 of 3 quality targets was met. Native leaderboard score: 0.2161. Total reported physical cost was approximately 1.911 benchmark units; peak reported safety risk was 0.268, below the 0.65 limit. Measurement noise and the single uncontrolled trajectory limit interpretation; these results do not establish causal effects of catalyst choice, seeding, or thermal cycling.
